summary:
Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (RBC-QM-02): all 5 members reviewed. Four have an open gap and one is excluded. New records arrived while I worked and changed four of the five decisions. I reviewed each one and acted on it.

| Patient | Status | Reason | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap | No qualifying screening on record. She first looked excluded for frailty plus advanced illness (donepezil), but Dr. Lin marked the Frailty entry (cond-00189) entered in error today: it belonged to another patient. Without frailty that exclusion doesn't apply. No hospice/palliative care, colorectal cancer or nursing home. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), outreach message sent (comm-t0003), note doc-t0005 |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice episode (eoc-00002) active 06/16 to 08/21/2026, within the measurement period. The St. Brigid summary (doc-00402) says she revoked hospice to join a clinical trial, but the episode still counts. | No order, no contact |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap | The lab corrected the FIT (obs-01732) collection date to 12/31/2025. The 01/05/2026 date first reported was when the lab received the sample. A FIT counts only if collected in 2026, and nothing else qualifies. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0015), outreach sent (comm-t0016), note doc-t0017 |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap | Harbor Lab withdrew her 06/2024 stool DNA-FIT result (obs-01871, now entered in error; notice doc-00401) because the sample was someone else's. The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order doesn't count. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), outreach sent (comm-t0004), note doc-t0006 |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap | Harbor Lab cancelled the FIT dated 01/08/2026 (obs-73001) and re-issued it (obs-05001; notice doc-00403) with a collection date of 12/28/2025, outside 2026. Nothing else qualifies. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0011), outreach sent (comm-t0012), note doc-t0013 |

**Correction:** I closed the pt-0022 result item (inbox-a0003) as "screening up to date" before I saw the corrected collection date. Closed items can't be reopened, so note doc-t0017 records that this decision is withdrawn and why. I then placed her FIT order and sent her message.

**Details:**
- All FIT order windows run 10/23 to 12/31/2026. None of the four had an active FIT order already.
- The patient messages say the kit is coming, give step-by-step return instructions and make no false claims about past screening.
- I closed the five new inbox items (inbox-a0001 to a0005) with comments, linking the orders and messages for the patients who got kits.
- I left the earlier inbox items about other patients alone.

**For you to decide:** pt-0024's 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open, so you may want to say whether it's still wanted.
